notes.title: Black Camelot is live on STEAM
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45104204/f6ec04f7a94c7e73d6d98ee7934ecf91088045ad.png[/img]
I am excited to inform you that Black Camelot is finally live on Steam in the Coming Soon section. The game is now available for wishlisting and following.

As for the development itself, how long the game will be at this stage cannot be predicted with certainty, but what is certain is that by the end of the year, a short DEMO will be released that will more clearly present the gameplay and the game in general.

That being said, feel free to follow, join the discussion, or ask any questions related to the game in the Steam group.

All the best. MV.
